This page is an orientation to the community's modding resources. Tool requirements and game-version compatibility can change, so follow the documentation maintained by each tool's authors.

== Before you begin ==

* Use a copy of ''New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe'' that you obtained legally. This wiki does not provide game files.
* Read the current requirements and setup information from each tool's upstream repository before using it.
* Keep an untouched backup of your own files and follow the instructions for your specific tool and game version.
* Treat community findings as version-specific unless a source says otherwise.

== Choose a path ==

; I want to make a level
: Start with [[Yaz0moto]], then see [[Level Design]].
; I want to explore custom code
: Read about [[SweetDX]] and review its repository for current requirements.
; I want to play the featured community project
: Visit [[Steam's New Super Mario Bros. Deluxe]] for project links and release details. Verify the current version before installing.
; I want to investigate how the game works
: See [[Game Research]] for source and confidence guidelines.

== Ask for help ==

For tool-specific support, use the issue tracker or documentation linked from the tool's upstream repository. For project announcements and community discussion, use the [https://discord.gg/YVtNsKzYTg community Discord]. Do not post private account, console, or personal information in public help requests.

== Contribute ==

You can improve this wiki by correcting outdated information, adding sourced notes, or documenting a reproducible workflow. See [[Contributing]] and [[Community Guidelines]].
